description: Static, case-local eligibility fixture for an outer-composed adapter around dsh-config-migrate. The dynamic plugin is parsed and audited, never executed by this E1/E2 runner.

plugin.artifact_policy: source-only; do not claim source-to-binary reproducibility

E1.name: dynamic-plugin identity, contract and load seam
thresholds: pinned commit, package and version identity match 100%
host.js and client.js are both present under the pinned package root and parse as function bodies
dsh.plugin.host/client is explicit and dsh.bundle is not inferred
dynamic plugin is not silently added to dsh.profile.bundles
adapter id/version is bound to the pinned plugin identity
plugin source is never executed during E1/E2

E2.name: dynamic-plugin capability and installation safety
thresholds: all source paths remain under the isolated bundle root
ctx, bridge, filesystem, settings and subprocess requests are recorded against an allowlist
plugin policy cannot widen adapter policy; external paths, network and credentials are denied in this gate
lifecycle scripts, dependency ledger, license and artifact absence are recorded
registry install, real credential, external network and external effect count are 0
ZWorkbench canonical owner state is not created or modified

non_claims: E1/E2 pass is an adapter eligibility result within this isolated static gate, not runtime security certification.
The runner does not prove that arbitrary subprocess code is safe; future runtime execution must enforce the pinned-script and OS sandbox policy.
The dynamic plugin remains responsible for migration semantics; it does not own ZWorkbench run/effect/event/replay state.
No E3-E6 parity, product readiness, real Provider, real credential, remote exit or source-to-binary reproducible-build claim is made.
